final.summary: Outfall pH stayed near 11 for about nine and a half hours inside the batch treatment interval, showing untreated alkaline wastewater reached the outfall. During the same stretch ETP inflow was very low while intake stayed high and the equalization tank stayed mid-range, showing water left the tank around the ETP rather than through it. Conductivity stayed high with the high pH, so this was not dilution.

explanations.label: Normal operation: batch wastewater treated through working ETP
Bypass: untreated wastewater sent around ETP to outfall
ETP stopped then equalization tank overflowed untreated
Meter fault: pH or flow readings wrong

key_evidence.why: Outfall pH stayed near 11 for about 9.5 hours, showing raw alkaline water reached the outfall.
ETP inflow was far below its normal level while intake stayed high, showing flow went around the ETP.
Tank level stayed mid-range and never filled, ruling out overflow and pointing to a bypass valve.
Tank balance shows a large unaccounted volume leaving by another route than the ETP.
Conductivity stayed high with the high pH, ruling out dilution as the cause.
pH feed does not repeat another day, ruling out a replayed feed.

final.scope_line: Based on intake, ETP inflow, power, tank level, outfall pH and conductivity records for 2026-10-13 14:00 to 2026-10-14 18:00. Does not measure every pollutant.
limitations: Outfall flow is missing for the high-pH stretch, so the exact bypass volume cannot be quantified.
Power after 00:40 on 2026-10-14 was not checked within the check budget, so aeration recovery there is not assessed.
Factory logbook, maintenance record and operator statement claim normal operation and only brief aerator work; they are claims, not facts, and are contradicted by the signals.
No lab BOD result or power meter photo was available to provide physical confirmation beyond the separate signals.

result.note: ETP balance: treated flow reaching the outfall vs outfall flow (same time). Boundary balance: intake vs outfall + losses + sludge water + tank storage change (reuse cancels). Tank balance: wastewater arriving (estimated from intake) vs ETP inflow + storage change; unaccounted water left the tank another way, or was intake water that never became wastewater. null means a required signal is under 80% coverage.
